10027: Under the banner of the Chamber of Rising Sun, believers of other deities vanished like snow beneath a blazing sun. Build defenses to hold off the gathering Fanatical Believers.
10028: The Fanatical Believers have been driven away, but the Dew relic protecting Cargen Town was also stolen. The town will now slowly dry up under the scorching sun and drifting sands. Talk to the elder to learn what they plan to do.
10029: In the Berne tavern, you met a fortune-teller who seemed real and fake. Somehow, a strange Arktur appeared in your pocket. Leave Berne and wait for Gu Qianshan to study the card.
10030: You found yourself in an unknown place, darkness blocking the moonlight like a curtain with life, cutting off your path. Go toward the light and wait for sunrise.
10031: The fortune-teller fell silent, lost in thought, while the shadows grew even more rampant. These terrifying shadow creatures didn't seem to be under her control, but they were connected to her. Survive and hold out until the fortune-teller wakes up.
10033: In the tavern, a mysterious storyteller caught your attention. Located at the border, unusual events here often come with danger. Track the Straw-caped Stranger to prevent any trouble.
10034: The mysterious ally who stopped the Straw-caped Stranger turns out to be Pei Xingzhong, whom you haven't seen for a long time. The stranger has escaped. Follow the elder's guidance to track them down.
10035: The Straw-caped Stranger disappeared, leaving behind only a rusty token. Return to Yue-Gu and listen to Pei Xingzhong explain the whole story.
10036: After a long wait, the token left by the Straw-caped Stranger is finally deciphered. Head to Yue-Gu to keep searching for the stranger's whereabouts.
10037: The incense and candles Old Yue needed have been bought. Follow Pei Xingzhong to the ritual site and perform the unsealing ritual.
10038: As the token was being exchanged, the cult assassin who had been hiding for ages finally showed up, but luckily failed. Winds rise and clouds gather, ambushes appear everywhere—protect Old Yue inside the magic array, and don't let the enemy get close.
10040: You survived wave after wave of attacks, and finally, the Straw-caped Stranger steps out. The ritual is almost complete—make sure Old Yue stays safe.
10041: The situation took a sudden turn—the path you followed to uncover the truth was a trap all along. With the last of his strength, Old Yue cleared the fog, then collapsed as well.
10042: Old Yue fell in the snowy woods of Yue-Gu; the cult he was tracking has claimed yet another life. Go deeper into the snowfields to lay Old Yue to rest.
10043: Old Yue has gone, and Pei Xingzhong is waiting at the Tavern. The magic array still needs one more material—go to the merchant near town and buy special incense candles.
10044: A mysterious group of assassins attacked Gu Qianshan near Wang-Gui. The Zhe-Jing Division showed up late with an invitation to meet. Head to the tavern in Luan City to meet with the Zhe-Jing Division.
10045: This assassination is closely tied to the mysterious sect in distant Nan-Xi—the Gui-Gu Sect. Wait for Chao Feng to arrange the next steps.
10046: Baron Cohen has unsealed the Codex of Akzar, but seems to have been driven mad by the mad god. Can you help him recover from his madness?
10047: The Codex of Akzar was stolen by tomb robbers, and Baron Cohen wants to team up with you to get it back.
10048: According to the historian, the scroll you obtained is priceless. Get more scrolls from pirates and give them to the historian for deciphering.
10049: With enough samples, the historian might discover something beneath the rust. Wait for the historian to finish deciphering.
10050: The scrolls are from the age before the Mist Voyage—the golden age of the Fallen Elves. Go to the pirates' hideout and retrieve the relics they took.
10051: Even if the golden age faded away, the Fallen Elves still covet their past glory. Negotiate with the Fallen Elves Assassin and make your choice.
10054: With enough samples, the historian might discover something beneath the rust. Go back to Wang-Gui and discuss it with the historian.
10056: Even though the golden age is long gone, the Fallen Elves still cling to their former glory. The Shadow Walker has stated her terms—you need to make a choice.
10057: To track down the missing relic, the Caucaid missionary came to Chen-Yuan, but didn't make any progress. Ask around the nearby city about the relic.
10058: The traders are very cautious—you won't get any useful information until you earn their trust. Go back to Missionary Camp and discuss it with Geralt.
10059: Geralt gave up his pendant as a token of trust. Go to the tavern in Luan City and talk to the relic merchant.
10060: The missionary's ever-present pendant earned the merchant's trust. Go to the place the merchant mentioned and trade with his partner.
10061: As the relic changed hands, an apostle of the Rising arrived, making the atmosphere tense. Talk to the apostle and explain what happened.
10062: As the relic changed hands, the apostle of Sunrise arrived, making the atmosphere tense. Talk to the apostle and explain what happened.
10063: At Geralt's insistence, the apostle of Sunrise made a concession. Talk to Geralt to decide who gets the relic.
10065: The followers of the Chamber of Rising Sun are usually fanatical and hostile to outsiders, but one young priest showed rare kindness. Talk to the priest and hear his intentions.
10067: Jazal, the flag officer of Sanor Battalion, is working for Selamon and has some ties to Oriana. Go to the Ruined Church and ask about the location of the Sanor Battalion.
10068: Sanor Battalion is camped in the wastelands north of Torch Castle. Go north of Torch Castle and meet with Jazal.
10070: You've earned the recognition of the Sanor Battalion, but you'll still need a hefty sum of Ducats to get them to give up the contract. Jazal will reward you with a weapon.
10071: The deal with Jazal went surprisingly well—he won't be our enemy. Leave Jazal's camp, and Oriana seems to have something to say.
10072: Swayed by Selamon, the Knights Eternal Flame joined his side. Go to the knights' base and persuade them to return to the right path.
10073: Eternal Flame Knight left the judgment to the deity. After the ritual is completed, talk to the knights again.
10074: The knights did not answer and left their fate to the deity. Talk to Garcia to learn the details of the ritual.
10076: Eternal Flame Knight has chosen their fate, but this time, the Rising is no longer merciful. Return to Hammer Drop Castle and report to Garcia.
10080: Opportunities are everywhere in the city's daily life. Money, supplies, and connections are all valuable. Head to the Tavern and look for a suitable commission.
10081: Pei Xingzhong had a commission for you. Follow Pei Xingzhong's directions to the area near Luo-Shui Town.
10082: A Caucaidian caravan stuck in Luan City has reached out to you, but only if you have a strong team. Check in at the Guild in Luan City to reinforce your team, then discuss the deal.
10083: A Caucaidian caravan is recruiting guards for their return trip. Gather enough people and talk to the caravan leader.
10084: Plan carefully to stay undefeated. Return to Luan City and talk to the caravan leader.
10085: Even with bandits around, the caravan can't just stand still. Escort the caravan to Duan-Long Fort and stay alert.
10086: The Luan people are famous for their martial skills and craftsmanship in armor and swords. Their ancestral warriors are well-known everywhere. Go to Luo-Shui Town and hire some soldiers through the caravan's connections.
10087: Bandits are a real threat, but the caravan can't just stand still. Escort the caravan to Duan-Long Fort and stay alert.
10088: After a tough first battle, the Silver Key Society decided to retreat. The job is done—talk to the caravan leader.
10089: The Torch Carrier Merchants have given you a mysterious job. Meet the mysterious employer at the Corona tavern.
10090: Mrs. Kelly—art dealer and second-in-command of Torch Carrier Merchants—gave you a peculiar mission: intercept the caravan passing through Berne and get the goods for her.
10093: You completed Mrs. Kelly's task perfectly—the caravan vanished by the lake, and no one survived. Return to Corona and report to Mrs. Kelly.
10094: The innocent shouldn't be used as sacrifices in someone's plot. You got the goods, but let the caravan go. Return to Corona and report to Mrs. Kelly.
10095: Mrs. Kelly's tricks didn't do much. Head deep into the wasteland, catch the rebels she mentioned, and hand them over to Libraland as scapegoats.
10096: After dealing with the rebels, Mrs. Kelly appeared without a sound. Talk to her to wrap up this tough mission.
10097: The deserters with blood on their hands were the perfect scapegoats—they were already infamous for their crimes.
10098: Right as tensions rose, the president, Ben Williams, showed up and stopped the furious Mrs. Kelly. Talk to Williams to bring this to a close.
10099: A ranger squad from the Parliament of Dark Cliff sent a distress signal. Commissioned by Parliament, go to the Evgen Ruins and look for the squad.
10100: Just in time, surviving rangers got you out of danger. Talk to the survivors to learn what happened.
10101: The unopened Evgen Ruins were invaded, and the patrolling ranger squad suffered heavy losses. Escort the ranger captain back to Gery-Sand Castle and ask the Parliament for help.
10102: The accident at the ruins has been reported to the Parliament. While the mages discuss countermeasures, you should also get ready. Find Sif and discuss a Ranger-style plan with her.
10103: All the materials are ready, Sif has started making a secret weapon against mages. Wait a day, then go back to Gery-Sand Castle to find Sif.
10104: To deal with the Black-Robed Magician, Sif needs to prepare a special surprise for Ranger use. Collect one Grey Iron Dust, one Healing Potion, and one Stone Armor Scroll, and bring them to Sif.
10105: The secret weapon is ready, and the Mana energy at Evgen Ruins is becoming unstable. Return to Evgen Ruins and stop the Black-Robed Magician.
10106: The battle suddenly shifted—a Grand Mage from the Sharox Mage Tower appeared and destroyed the Black-Robed Magician completely. The secret treasure in his hand is now yours, and you have the right to decide its fate.
10107: The crisis at Evgen Ruins has finally passed. Return to Gery-Sand Castle and report the good news to the Parliament.
10108: Berne merchant Aimon invited you to join a special cross-border trade. Rest for a day, then find Aimon near Berne.
10109: Aimon's caravan is ready. Look for Aimon near the Berne.
10110: Aimon's Team is assembled. Enter the Mistwood from the northeast of Corona City; there won't be any patrols there.
10111: An unexpected interceptor caused a brief scare. Go through the Mistwood and reach the meeting place as planned.
10115: You rescued the clumsy girl Luo Shanshan. Go to the tower in the snowy forest to look for her companions.
10116: Even though Luo Shanshan messed up your plan, you still took down the bandits in the tower. Talk to Baron Cohen and escort him back to Lao-Chen.
10117: Baron Cohen wants to finish his tower exploration. Guard the ruined tower and wait for Baron Cohen to finish his job.
10118: With your help, Baron Cohen has completed his investigation. Return to Lao-Chen and speak with Baron Cohen.
10119: Based on Cohen's clues, there may be secrets from the Huan Dynasty hidden in the northern ruins. Search the Ruins of the Huan Dynasty.
10120: Bandits from the snow forest have a rumor that there are ghosts in the ruins. Go to the ruins and investigate the rumors.
10121: The ghost in the ruined wall was just an illusion, and the cause, an ancient wine vessel, has been obtained by Cohen. Escort Cohen back to Yue-Gu.
10122: The Wei-Yuan Agency's convoy was ambushed in the wasteland. As the only reinforcement, you accept the agency's request.
10123: The escorts can't spare time for revenge, but you do. Track down the bandits and avenge the victims.
10124: The bandit leader escaped, but at least they won't cause any more trouble. Return to the Wei-Yuan Agency and report to Instructor Wu.
10125: You refused the bandits' bribe. You found a secret murder contract on the leader's body. Go back to the Wei-Yuan Agency and report to Instructor Wu.
10191: It seems there really is a white-robed Ranger guarding the Shuang-Lin Town. Go to find her.
10192: You and Ji Yun defeated Whisper Cultist in the mountain and also confirmed her identity. Go back to the shepherd.
10195: The conflict between you and Doctor Huang has been resolved. He is going to give you a gift.
10196: After the private salt business was exposed, Doctor Huang fled to Caucaid with his salt gang members.
10197: Doctor Huang plans to meet you in person to clear up the misunderstanding.
10199: Between the Protectorate of Wu-Wei and Burningland, border conflict was rising again. By chance, you were involved in the disappearance of the Caucaid envoys, entrusted by Gu Qianshan from Honglu Temple to help investigate. After a break, go to Yue-Gu or Wang-Gui to keep digging.
10200: Zhao-Lin's Censorate was assassinated, and all clues led to the scheming Protectorate of Wu-Wei. Finish Yue-Gu's task and wait for new orders from Zhao-Lin.
10202: The Dragon Gang that plagued the northern territories has been eradicated. As promised, you borrow elite troops from Xu Zhao. Await new orders from Zhao-Lin.
10204: The bracelet merchant died in a tunnel collapse, but left a letter with contact details for his partner. Go to Berne and contact his partner as instructed in the letter.
10205: After a failed assassination attempt, you met the Veil Priestess Salem from the Sasin Dynasty. The two of you decided to team up and track down the escaped tomb robber. (To be continued)
10206: The crazed Believer was driven away, but the Dew gem that Cargen Town relies on was stolen by a mysterious black-clad Ranger. Go to the Hummingbird Guild and ask about the black-clad Ranger's identity. (To be continued)
10207: As dawn broke, everything in the night faded away, leaving only the words between Arctur and the fortune teller. Go to Twisted Ruin and cleanse the corruption there—you might find some clues.
10208: On the outskirts of Yue-Gu, while chasing a suspicious figure, you unexpectedly met Pei Xingzhong and heard rumors about Li Wang. Continue your journey and wait for news from Pei Xingzhong.
10209: The fate-detecting array turned out to be a trap set for you. Old Yue sacrificed himself to stop the array. Pei Xingzhong dropped his carefree act and decided to help you track down the Straw-caped Stranger figure. (To be continued)
10210: Something strange happened at the Gui-Gu Sect, and Gu Qianshan's senior brother, who usually leads the sect, seems to have other plans. Once things settle down at the border, the Zhe-Jing Division will arrange a trip to Nan-Xi.
10211: You hear a voice not of this world... not of this world, yet so clear. Pray you've gone mad—honestly, that's probably for the best.
10212: The plain-looking ship stranded on the beach hid the Fallen Elves' legacy from a hundred years past. You struck a deal with the Ark of Instinct Moon crew, trading the artifact for friendship.
10213: The plain-looking ship stranded on the beach hid the Fallen Elves' legacy from a century ago. After you knocked back the Ark of Instinct Moon crew who came for it, you claimed this ancient artifact. But watch out—the Fallen Elves never forget a grudge.
10214: The apostle of the Rising, once misled by hatred, regained some clarity after the deitydess turned him away and gave up the hunt for the relic. Use this relic from Orost wisely—don't bring shame to the deitydess.
10215: You found Jazal, the flag officer of the Sanor Battalion, and convinced him to tear up his contract with Selamon. The Sanor Battalion won't be facing you in battle anymore.
10216: You found Jazal, the flag officer of the Sanor Battalion, but didn't accept his terms. Maybe you'll cross paths on the battlefield soon.
10217: You brought Garcia's advice to the Eternal Flame Knight, but they turned it down. With no other choice, you defeated the Eternal Flame Knight—they won't be joining Selamon's side anymore.
10219: You ran into Pei Xingzhong at a Luan City restaurant and ended up handling a commission together. From Pei Xingzhong, you learned how to pick up contracts in the city.
10220: You helped the Caucaid Merchant escape an ambush by the Silver Key Society, earning the favor of the Torch Carrier Merchants. Their gratitude might come in handy on your journey.
10221: You finished Mrs. Kelly's quest, cold and efficient. She gave you a generous reward—and a grim nod of approval. When dealing with Mrs. Kelly, always watch your back.
10222: You completed Mrs. Kelly's quest, but showed some mercy. The merchants still met their end, but you did all you could. When dealing with Mrs. Kelly, always watch your back.
10223: When things get weird, something's up. You refused Mrs. Kelly's baseless demands, keeping yourself out of the Torch Carrier Merchants' power games. Chaos is the ladder, and caution is a virtue.
10224: The deserters with blood on their hands made perfect scapegoats—they already had plenty of sins. To survive here, you need to learn the rule of this world: chaos is the ladder.
10225: The old days are over; Mrs. Kelly's ruthless ways just don't fit the Merchants anymore. President Williams praised what you did and extended the friendship of the Torch Carrier Merchants to you.
10226: You resolved the crisis in the Evgen Ruins and finally got the long-delayed exploration permit. You presented the mysterious gem to the Parliament, earning the support of the top Grand Mage assembly in Burningland.
10227: You resolved the crisis in the Evgen Ruins and finally got the long-delayed exploration permit. You handed the mysterious gem over to Grand Mage Beirzek—his friendship is worth more than gold.
10228: You resolved the crisis in the Evgen Ruins and finally got the long-delayed exploration permit. You kept the mysterious gem for yourself—one day, you'll see its true value.
10229: You got Eamon safely to the foot of the Dragon-jaw Mountains. From there, he was on his own. Maybe he'll bring you the reward he promised, or maybe he'll just end up another skeleton in the icy wind. Nobody knows what's next.
10232: While traveling north of Lao-Chen, you stumbled upon Luo Shanshan being chased by bandits and later rescued Baron Cohen from a tower. It's clear that the historian's tale is far from over. (Strengthen your bond with Baron Cohen)
10233: Under the crumbling walls deep in the north, you helped Baron Cohen find a unique ancient relic. The secret of Snow Line City is within. Once it's unlocked, Baron Cohen will need your help again.
10234: With one timely act of bravery, you built a strong bond with the Wei-Yuan Agency. In this world, a good story is priceless.
10235: With one timely act of bravery, you built a strong bond with the Wei-Yuan Agency. In this world, a good story is priceless. This experience will keep paying off for you.
10236: To stop villagers from heading deep into the mountains, Ji Yun denied her existence, and the shepherd made his own choice.
